This was so lovely to read thank you!! It’s been a tough week, especially for my face damn every time I catch site of myself I see something new that’s wrong,, maybe it’s the sleep deprivation or trying to act not stressed for my friends so we’re not all panicking. Either way it’s nice to be told I can take a moment for myself and that I don’t always have to listen to the miserable insecure voice in my head.

It’s just rough when every time I see myself even for a fleeting moment I notice these small problems and the little things that are off about my face, I know it’s futile to worry about them and no one else even notices but hormones and shit make me hate myself. I’m trying my best not to care so much and present myself as happy rather than pretty or ugly and I think the 48hr long nap I plan on having this weekend helps.

(Not yet in 6th form but) when I got accepted I was told if my attendance was below 95% in any subjects the school would not enter me into the exams for that subject.

All I remember from having chicken pox is getting a few days off school and hanging out with my cousins so they could get it. I have one tiny white scar on my stomach because I never listened and itched regardless but pretty much everyone I know has a chicken pox scar. I have no memory of it being uncomfortable or painful, and as someone who hates needles I’m happy to have one less vaccine.
